holdings.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd

The company raised product prices in September and planned further hikes from October 1, 2026.
Net profit was ₹263 crore on revenue of ₹5,607 crore in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.03% weight, it was the second largest positive contributor over 3 months (+0.404% contribution, returning 19.9%) supporting the 24.8% Industrials allocation.

portfolio.statement: Mahindra Manulife Mid Cap Fund is an equity fund allocating over 53% of its portfolio to Financials and Industrials.
interp: The top 10 holdings represent 25.1% of the ₹5,058 crore portfolio, keeping single-stock concentration moderate.
Over the past 3 months, gains in Coforge and APL Apollo Tubes were overshadowed by drops across financial and industrial holdings, pulling fund returns to -6.9%.
portfolio.line: Performance is driven by domestic lending and industrial manufacturing, offset by niche technology services.

drivers.text: Coforge contributed +0.779% to fund returns over 3 months, gaining 29.4% while launching enterprise AI frameworks.
APL Apollo Tubes contributed +0.404% after returning 19.9% over 3 months, aided by a 13% YoY volume growth to 963,143 tonnes.
IndusInd Bank created the largest single holding drag over 3 months (-0.466% contribution) following a -14.62% decline.

themes.title: Domestic Credit and Financial Intermediation
themes.text: Extensive exposure across private banks, state-owned lenders, asset management, and NBFCs.
holdings: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd

themes.title: Industrial Manufacturing and Fabrication
themes.text: Holdings levered to building infrastructure, cabling, and structural steel tubes.

macro.factor: Domestic Lending and Interest Rate Trajectory
macro.why: Interest rate revisions and lending margins directly alter financing profitability across the fund's banks and lenders.
Enterprise technology budgets and foreign client adoption dictate revenue growth and margin durability.

priced_in.text: APL Apollo Tubes' 19.9% 3-month return reflects its record volume delivery of 963,143 tonnes and product price hikes.
Bank of Maharashtra's low gross NPA of 1.45% and net NPA of 0.13% are reflected in its reported financial metrics.

could_change.title: Shift in Credit Quality Cycles
could_change.text: Unexpected asset quality slippage or rising credit costs in mid-tier lenders would pressure the fund's heavy 28.5% Financials allocation.

could_change.title: Industrial Raw Material Cost Swings
could_change.text: Sudden shifts in input costs and volume momentum could impact margins for fabrication and cabling holdings.

portfolio.risk_note: With Financials (28.5%) and Industrials (24.8%) making up over 53% of assets, the portfolio is highly exposed to domestic credit expansion and physical Capex cycles.
